items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 20 November 2026 10:00am
items.description:
##Today##

Today will be dry with sunny/ clear spells and a light breeze. Maximum temperature of 9°C. Temperatures will quickly fall after sunset, bringing another risk of frost and ice. Comments: Risk of frost and ice later.


##Temperature##

##Tomorrow##

Another chilly start tomorrow with a risk of frost and ice in places. Dry with clear/sunny spells. Light and variable winds, settling to the east and steadily strengthening, then becoming a fresh to strong southeasterly in the evening. Maximum temperature of 9°C. Comments: Risk of frost and ice at first. Strong winds later.

Sunday will be dry with sunny intervals, turning hazy at times. Strong easterly winds, steadily decreasing. Maximum temperature 9°C. Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping (AM). Strong winds.

##Monday, 23 November 2026##

Monday will be dry with bright or sunny intervals for much of the day. Cloud gradually thickening, with the risk of a band of rain arriving in the evening or early in the night. Moderate southeast winds increasing strong later. Maximum temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds developing.
